_comment: What the published connector slot holds while a release is being prepared. Read by scripts/connector_release_state.py, which the release guards use. Remove the pending fields once the installation origin serves 0.6.2, or the next real lag will be invisible.
pending_reason: 0.6.2 is signed and published as a GitHub release in agntnexus/agentnexus-connector: tag v0.6.2 on commit daac97feed007b212754083515c4e0e283eda8af, agentnexus_sdk-0.6.2-py3-none-any.whl, 256197 bytes, sha256 300b6485253282863830d78090cffb7ac00f852e13c20492b437e48dff2c8232, reproducible from that revision with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1789817905. Those release assets are verification copies, not an install source. The slot below still reads 0.6.1 because the installation origin still serves 0.6.1: reaching agntnexus.com needs the signed tree committed into connector-release/, a new observer image and a guarded digest rollout, which is a separate, separately approved deployment. Publishing a release is not deploying one.
operator_step: python scripts/build_connector_release.py --signing-key <path outside this repository> --public-agent-endpoint-approved --source-date-epoch 1789817905 --output connector-release && python scripts/register_connector_release.py 0.6.2 --summary "The published source URL names the public Connector repository."
the_build_difference_is_fixed: #116 added packages/agent-sdk-python/LICENSE, the repository's own licence copied byte for byte, so setuptools now ships dist-info/licenses/LICENSE from a build here as it already did from the public repository. A build from this repository at v0.6.2 with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1789817905 is byte-identical to the published wheel -- same filename, size, entry order, timestamps, CRCs and sha256 300b6485253282863830d78090cffb7ac00f852e13c20492b437e48dff2c8232 -- verified from two fresh clones, and the published manifest and signature verify against that rebuild unchanged. The operator step above therefore no longer supplies a wheel with --wheel. The published 0.6.2 wheel itself was not altered and could not be: its bytes are immutable at their address. What changed is that this repository can now reproduce them.
one_caveat_on_that_equality: The licence text enters the wheel as the working tree holds it, so the equality above is measured on a checkout with CRLF line endings, which is what core.autocrlf produces on the Windows operator workstation the release was built on and what the published wheel embeds: 201 CRLF pairs, no bare LF. Measured rather than assumed: forcing the LF form produces 256180 bytes and sha256 df55cb3ff743dbce42a4e38de112733ec6afa9acbba0d4b0cd88fabb71a7bf74, differing only in the licence entry and the RECORD digest that covers it. No line-ending normalisation was introduced, because normalising would change the bytes against a wheel that is already published. Pinning it deliberately is worth its own decision.
after_publishing: Set published_version to 0.6.2, remove pending_version, pending_reason, operator_step, the_build_difference_is_fixed and one_caveat_on_that_equality, add 0.6.2 to PUBLISHED_VERSIONS in apps/forum-api/tests/test_connector_bootstrap.py, and commit that together with the signed artefacts and the three registrations. Do that when the origin serves 0.6.2, not when the GitHub release exists.
